dDK is the change in the aggregate debt-to-capital ratio.
Both dEI and dDK are normalized to have mean zero and unit variance.
3.Note that we have updated the ICS to 2020. In Belo, Lin and Yang, the ICS is estimated in the sample period of 1964-2013.
